settings.title: Settings
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.kutt_fqdn_helper: Short links use this domain, like https://kutt.example.org/abc123
settings.site_name_helper: Name shown in the Kutt pages and e-mails
settings.link_length_helper: Characters of the generated short addresses, from 3 to 32
settings.link_length_invalid: Enter a whole number from 3 to 32
settings.link_custom_alphabet_helper: Characters of the generated addresses. The default leaves out look-alikes such as o, O, 0, i, I, l and 1.
settings.disallow_registration_helper: Only the admin creates user accounts. On the first visit Kutt asks to create the admin account.
settings.disallow_anonymous_links_helper: Only logged-in users can create short links
settings.disallow_login_form_helper: Users log in with OpenID Connect only
settings.login_form_needs_oidc: Enable OpenID Connect first: without the login form nobody could log in
settings.enable_rate_limit_helper: Limit the requests to some API routes, against abuse
settings.server_ip_address_helper: Shown to users who add their own domain, for its A record. Display only.
settings.server_cname_address_helper: Shown to users who add their own domain, for its CNAME record. Display only.
settings.custom_domain_use_https_helper: Short links of custom domains start with https://. Each domain needs a certificate.
settings.mail_on_description: Kutt sends e-mail through the smarthost of the cluster: password reset, e-mail verification and reports.
settings.mail_off_description: Configure the smarthost in the cluster settings to enable password reset, e-mail verification and reports.
settings.mail_from_helper: Sender of the Kutt e-mails, like Kutt <noreply@example.org>. Empty: the site name at noreply@ the Kutt hostname.
settings.report_email_helper: Receives the reports of malicious links. Empty: reports are off.
settings.oidc_enabled_helper: Users log in with an OpenID Connect provider, such as Keycloak or authentik
settings.oidc_issuer_helper: Kutt reads the provider settings from this URL. Register the redirect URL https://<Kutt hostname>/login/oidc in the provider.
settings.oidc_client_id_helper: Client ID registered in the provider
settings.oidc_client_secret_helper: Client secret registered in the provider
settings.oidc_client_secret_keep: A secret is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.oidc_email_claim_helper: Claim that holds the user e-mail address. Default: email
settings.oidc_prompt_helper: Optional prompt parameter, like login or consent
settings.oidc_issuer_anyOf: Must be a URL starting with https://
